questions.question: How much did California collect in motor fuel sales taxes in fiscal year 2022, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_government_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='2022 ASFIN', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
ca_col = header_row[header_row == 'California'].index[0]
item_col = df[0].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
row_idx = df[item_col.str.contains('Motor Fuels Sales Tax', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
result = int(df.iat[row_idx, ca_col])

questions.question: Did Texas collect more in total tax revenue than New York in fiscal year 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_government_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='2022 ASFIN', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
tx_col = header_row[header_row == 'Texas'].index[0]
ny_col = header_row[header_row == 'New York'].index[0]
item_col = df[0].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
row_idx = df[item_col == 'Total Taxes'].index[0]
tx_val = float(df.iat[row_idx, tx_col])
ny_val = float(df.iat[row_idx, ny_col])
result = 'yes' if tx_val > ny_val else 'no'

questions.question: Which three states spent the most on hospitals in fiscal year 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_government_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='2022 ASFIN', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
item_col = df[0].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
row_idx = df[item_col == 'Hospitals'].index[0]
state_names = header_row.iloc[2:]
values = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[row_idx, 2:].replace('X', None), errors='coerce')
s = pd.Series(values.values, index=state_names.values).dropna()
result = list(s.nlargest(3).index)

questions.question: Between Florida and Georgia, which state spent more on highways in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_government_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='2022 ASFIN', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
fl_col = header_row[header_row == 'Florida'].index[0]
ga_col = header_row[header_row == 'Georgia'].index[0]
item_col = df[0].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
row_idx = df[item_col == 'Highways'].index[0]
fl_val = float(df.iat[row_idx, fl_col])
ga_val = float(df.iat[row_idx, ga_col])
result = 'Florida' if fl_val > ga_val else 'Georgia'

questions.question: How many states had education expenditures exceeding 30,000,000 thousand dollars in fiscal year 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_government_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='2022 ASFIN', header=None)
item_col = df[0].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
row_idx = df[item_col == 'Education'].index[0]
state_values = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[row_idx, 2:], errors='coerce')
result = int((state_values > 30000000).sum())

questions.question: What was the combined severance tax revenue collected by Texas, New Mexico, and Alaska in fiscal year 2022, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_government_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='2022 ASFIN', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
item_col = df[0].astype(str).str.replace('\u00a0', ' ').str.strip()
row_idx = df[item_col == 'Severance Taxes'].index[0]
states = ['Texas', 'New Mexico', 'Alaska']
cols = [header_row[header_row == s].index[0] for s in states]
result = int(sum(pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[row_idx, cols])))
